evidence_slice: The London Borough of Bromley Local Plan page states that the Bromley Local Plan was adopted on 16 January 2019 and is the statutory Development Plan for the borough. The adopted Local Plan lists Bromley Civic Centre among the sites allocated to include residential development. The public Bromley planning_local_plan_data_06 FeatureServer exposes layer 45 named Site Allocations; the layer is an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer in British National Grid EPSG:27700, with sitename and sitereference fields, and records a data last edit date of 3 January 2024.
binding_method: adopted borough Local Plan residential allocation plus authority planning GIS Polygon layer; exact feature extraction and canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
source_file_sha256_reason: The official Local Plan web page and ArcGIS service metadata were accessed through public web transport; raw Local Plan PDF bytes and exact feature-response bytes were not acquired, so no source-file hash is fabricated.
